- **No substitute:** I didn't pick another Spotify brand, per Rule 1. Steps 3–9 (Video filter, the three channel legs) were not run.
- **Open question:** The report notes that a missing grant for lfiqa can't be ruled out from the UI.
- **Follow-up:** Other cases with the same Thursday row (QA-29123, QA-29234, QA-29116, QA-20537 and others) will likely hit the same gap. Someone needs to confirm whether the brand was renamed or removed, or grant it to lfiqa.
